name: SplitText
description: GSAP-style SplitText headline that splits into chars, words, or measured lines and animates each piece in from a configurable offset, 3D tilt, opacity, and blur with real power/expo/back/elastic eases and start/center/end/edges/random staggers.
a11yNotes: The full sentence is rendered once in a visually hidden span; the split pieces are aria-hidden so screen readers never hear letter-by-letter output. The heading element is configurable via `as`. Under prefers-reduced-motion the text renders in its settled state with no tween, and line splitting re-measures on resize via ResizeObserver.

propsApi.name: splitBy
propsApi.description: Unit each animated piece is made of; lines are measured from real wraps.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Duration of each piece's tween in seconds.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between consecutive pieces in seconds.

propsApi.name: staggerFrom
propsApi.description: Where the stagger wave starts from.

propsApi.name: delay
propsApi.description: Delay before the first piece starts, in seconds.

propsApi.name: fromY
propsApi.description: Starting vertical offset of each piece in pixels.

propsApi.name: fromRotateX
propsApi.description: Starting 3D rotation around the X axis in degrees.

propsApi.name: color
propsApi.description: Text color (defaults to the theme foreground).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element (CSS variables included).
